This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]]''' was part of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he and other Death Watch Mandalorians guarded the [[Death Watch hideout]] on the moon [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]].

He was later present with Death Watch commander [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] when Vizsla and [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] planned the take over of Mandalore.

==Behind the scenes==
The Death Watch trooper was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]], who also provided the voice for [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] in the same episode.
